notes.title: Demo for "Part III" is Coming Soon!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33268423/bca344fce4455c76cb8debb886ff8c13dad847e8.png[/img]
Delicious dishes must be savored at the right time, and the music is about to begin.
We apologize for keeping you waiting for so long. Following "Part I" and "Part II", we are excited to announce that  "Fantastic Danmaku Festival Part III" will have its demo released just before the 2025 Next Fest! The demo will be available from:

[b]February 12, 2025, 10 AM - March 3, 2025, 10 AM (Pacific Time)[/b]

During this time, players can enjoy the tutorial stage and the first three stages of the game. We welcome everyone to try it out and provide us with your valuable feedback!

If you have any thoughts or questions about the demo, feel free to leave a comment or contact us via email at: 
[u]touhou_fdf@outlook.com[/u]

Wishing you a Merry Christmas!

Update 180822
notes.notes:
Fixed the difference between the replay of a single stage and the reality.
Fixed the problem that the initial point is 0 when replaying a single stage. But it cannot immediately work on replays that created before this update is released. Replay from the beginning in order to record missed values again. When values are indeed recorded, a notification sound will be played. Any single stage will be normally replayed after the whole recording process is completed.
